source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The accepted DiscardOfflineMsg clears storeToken, sets offlineMessageSize to zero, marks the key non-offline and commits the database. The source calls out that MarkOffline alone did not clear all metadata in this path. For this invalidation API, keep all three facts together instead of clearing only the flag. This is a scoped current contract; return values from these final mutations are not all checked here, so the source does not establish a transaction or successful disk commit. No database-failure test was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.
title: Offline-copy invalidation clears token, size and Offline state together
